formattedAddress: 115, Taiwan, Taipei City, Nangang District, Sanzhong Village, Jingmao 2nd Rd, 66號2 樓

text.text:
I visited this restaurant in the exhibition area with high expectations, but unfortunately, the experience was disappointing.
The receptionist’s attitude wasn’t friendly (short middles aged woman in black shirt) . She’s only sit and do nothing not even asking customers and waiting to be asked.
She’s not suitable for a busy, well-known Restaurant where customer service should be a priority.
Additionally, the food was far from what I expected—very bland and lacking the authentic flavors I enjoyed at a similar restaurant in Songjiang Nanjing.
The taste here did not compare well to the vibrant and rich flavors I experienced there.
I hope the management addresses both the service and food quality to better meet customer expectations. The one in songjiang Nanjing has better service, attitude and food!

text.text: This is one of my favorite restaurants. Every dish is made with good quality ingredients and well-thought out so that there is something interesting and vibrant to sense. A wide variety of flavors, textures, etc. Wonderful food!
